# scripts/Visual/SeveredPart.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Visual/SeveredPart.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Detached rigid body created by Humanoid.sever(), with a frozen skeleton copy showing only the cut part.
Bleeds, tumbles, can be carried/thrown, and joins the bodies group for guard discovery.
The oldest part is removed above MAX_PARTS; physics uses body layer 4.

Base: `RigidBody3D`. Registered class: `none`.
